roles.name: AI & LLM Engineer
roles.description: Architects, fine-tunes, and deploys frontier generative AI models, multi-agent systems, and production RAG pipelines.
responsibilities: Architect and optimize enterprise RAG pipelines with vector databases
Fine-tune foundation models (LoRA, QLoRA) on domain-specific datasets
Deploy scalable inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Ollama)
Implement autonomous multi-agent orchestration frameworks
roles.careerPath: ML Engineer -> AI & LLM Engineer -> Principal AI Architect -> VP of Artificial Intelligence

roles.name: MLOps Engineer
roles.description: Automates the continuous integration, deployment, monitoring, and scaling of machine learning and LLM models in production.
responsibilities: Automate continuous training, validation, and deployment pipelines (CI/CD/CT)
Manage distributed model training clusters with Ray and Kubernetes
Monitor live model performance, data drift, and latency anomalies
Maintain production feature stores and metadata tracking systems
roles.careerPath: DevOps Engineer -> MLOps Engineer -> Lead MLOps Architect -> Head of Platform Engineering

roles.name: Cloud Security Architect
roles.description: Architects IAM boundaries, Zero Trust network segments, cloud governance policies, and threat protection.
responsibilities: Architect Zero Trust security perimeters across multi-cloud environments
Enforce Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and automated remediation
Design identity federation, least-privilege IAM, and cryptographic key vaults
Lead incident response architectures and threat modeling exercises
roles.careerPath: Security Engineer -> Senior Cloud Security Architect -> Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

roles.name: Data Engineer
roles.description: Builds and maintains scalable data pipelines and architectures for collecting, storing, and processing large volumes of data.
responsibilities: Build scalable real-time and batch ELT/ETL data pipelines
Architect modern lakehouse warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
Optimize distributed SQL queries, partitioning, and columnar compression
Ensure data governance, cataloging, and automated data quality testing
roles.careerPath: Junior Data Analyst -> Data Engineer -> Lead Data Architect -> VP of Data Engineering

roles.name: Data Analyst
roles.description: Interprets data, analyzes trends, and produces actionable insights to support business decisions.
responsibilities: Synthesize complex transactional datasets into actionable business insights
Build executive dashboards and KPI reporting suites in Tableau and Power BI
Perform statistical cohort and cohort-retention analyses
Partner with product managers to define tracking specs and metrics
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate
roles.careerPath: Junior Analyst -> Data Analyst -> Senior BI Consultant -> Head of Analytics

roles.name: Data Scientist
roles.description: Extracts insights from data using advanced analytics, statistics, and machine learning, often building predictive models.
responsibilities: Formulate hypothesis testing and rigorous A/B experiment evaluation frameworks
Develop predictive classification, regression, and time-series models
Extract behavioral patterns using feature engineering and dimensional reduction
Present data-driven strategic recommendations to executive stakeholders
roles.careerPath: Data Analyst -> Data Scientist -> Staff Data Scientist -> Chief Data Officer

roles.name: ML Engineer
roles.description: Specializes in deploying, optimizing, and maintaining machine learning models in production environments.
responsibilities: Train, optimize, and quantize deep neural networks for production workloads
Scale training algorithms across multi-GPU / multi-node clusters
Serve low-latency model APIs via Triton and FastAPI
Implement automated retraining triggers based on concept drift
roles.careerPath: Software Engineer -> ML Engineer -> Senior AI Systems Architect -> Head of ML

roles.name: DBMS
roles.description: Designs, implements, and manages databases, ensuring data integrity, performance, and security.
responsibilities: Design normalized and denormalized relational schemas and document models
Tune query execution plans, indexes, buffer pools, and vacuum parameters
Implement active-active replication, sharding, and high availability clustering
Automate backup verification and disaster recovery procedures
roles.careerPath: Junior DBA -> DBMS Specialist -> Senior Database Architect -> Director of Infrastructure

roles.name: Database Administrator
roles.description: Maintains and secures databases, performs tuning, backup, recovery, and ensures high availability.
responsibilities: Manage enterprise database health, clustering, and storage provisioning
Perform database patch upgrades, migrations, and schema cutovers with zero downtime
Enforce database security policies, transparent data encryption, and access auditing
Monitor connection pooling and transaction lock contention
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate
roles.careerPath: Systems Admin -> Database Administrator -> Lead DBA -> Infrastructure Manager

roles.name: Business Analyst
roles.description: Bridges business needs and technology solutions by analyzing requirements and defining specifications.
responsibilities: Translate business requirements into detailed technical user stories and PRDs
Facilitate stakeholder discovery sessions and process mapping workshops
Perform gap analysis and financial cost-benefit modeling for tech initiatives
Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and rollout change management
roles.careerPath: Junior BA -> Business Analyst -> Senior Product Analyst -> Director of Product Strategy

roles.name: Research Scientist
roles.description: Conducts advanced research on algorithms, models, and data-driven methods, often publishing findings.
responsibilities: Conduct foundational research in artificial intelligence, algorithms, or cryptography
Author peer-reviewed publications for top conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR)
Prototype novel neural architectures and mathematical proofs
Translate theoretical scientific breakthroughs into applied engineering solutions
roles.careerPath: Postdoctoral Researcher -> Research Scientist -> Principal Scientist -> Head of AI Research

roles.name: Data Steward
roles.description: Ensures data quality, governance, and compliance across the organization.
responsibilities: Enforce enterprise data governance, privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA), and classification
Maintain enterprise business glossaries, data dictionaries, and lineage tracking
Resolve data discrepancies and establish data validation standards
Collaborate with security and legal teams to define retention policies
roles.careerPath: Data Specialist -> Data Steward -> Data Governance Manager -> Chief Privacy Officer

roles.name: Data Architect
roles.description: Designs and oversees the data architecture, including data models, integration, and flows.
responsibilities: Design enterprise-wide data models, lakehouse blueprints, and stream-processing architectures
Evaluate and select distributed database technologies (OLTP vs OLAP)
Establish data mesh domains, governance guardrails, and data contract standards
Align technical data strategy with long-term business roadmap
roles.careerPath: Senior Data Engineer -> Data Architect -> Principal Enterprise Architect -> VP of Data

roles.name: Full Stack

roles.careerPath: Junior Full Stack -> Full Stack Engineer -> Lead Engineer -> VP of Engineering

Implement state management, client-side caching, and offline capabilities

roles.name: Back End

Architect RESTful, GraphQL, and gRPC application programming interfaces
Implement distributed caching layers (Redis) and message brokers (Kafka)
Perform SQL tuning, database migrations, and ACID transaction isolation
roles.careerPath: Junior Backend -> Backend Engineer -> Senior Backend Architect -> CTO

roles.name: API
roles.description: Designs and implements interfaces for communication between different software components or services, often using RESTful or GraphQL standards.

Maintain backwards compatibility through semantic versioning and deprecation lifecycles
Monitor API latency SLAs, error budgets, and developer SDK usability

roles.name: Server

roles.careerPath: Systems Admin -> Server Infrastructure Engineer -> Senior Platform Engineer

Configure next-gen firewalls, IPSec VPN tunnels, and load balancers
Troubleshoot packet loss and jitter using deep packet inspection (Wireshark)
roles.careerPath: Network Tech -> Network Engineer -> Senior Network Architect -> Director of Network Ops

roles.name: DevOps
roles.description: Bridges development and operations by automating software delivery, infrastructure changes, and monitoring.

Deploy and maintain production Kubernetes clusters and service meshes
Establish observability dashboards and automated incident paging policies

roles.careerPath: Cloud Admin -> Cloud Engineer -> Cloud Architect -> VP of Cloud Infrastructure

Investigate security incidents, SIEM alerts, and forensic artifact captures

roles.careerPath: Security Analyst -> Security Engineer -> Principal Security Architect -> CISO

Integrate automated test runs into CI/CD build gates

Author customer-facing knowledge base articles and troubleshooting runbooks

Maintain Jira boards and team throughput reporting metrics
